name: Horse mackerel
description: Cape horse mackerel (Trachurus capensis) - a deep-bodied schooling carangid and one of the system's major mid-level predators, targeted by midwater trawlers. Life-stage group of the source model's juvenile and adult horse-mackerel stanzas, measured separately and pooled here because the two stanzas form one population: juveniles eat mesozooplankton, adults larger zooplankton.
